title: Echo Sampler: tenant-safe edge prober for shadow traffic
creator: Asha Patel
description: Introduce a lightweight "echo sampler" component that safely duplicates a bounded fraction of production requests to a sandboxed runtime for downstream model/variant comparison. The goal is to give PMs and SREs high-fidelity shadow signals (latency, token cost, response divergence) while ensuring strict tenant isolation and hard cost caps.
background: We already have broad shadowing experiments but lack a low-friction, tenant-aware prober that: (a) isolates transient artifacts per tenant and prevents accidental billed explosion, (b) provides reproducible sampling across request types, and (c) surfaces actionable divergence signals for canary rollouts and auto-rollback policies. Current ad-hoc mirror pipelines are hard to budget and risk noisy billing and quota exhaustion for customers.
proposal: Build 'Echo Sampler' as a proxy-side component that: 1) applies configurable sampling policies (stratified by tenant, route, and weight), 2) opens ephemeral sandbox sessions per-tenancy for processing duplicated traffic, 3) enforces a per-tenant credit tether and global fiscal throttle, and 4) emits structured evaluation artifacts to the rollout dashboard for automated A/B/rollback decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Echo Sampler can duplicate requests for a configurable route at 0.1%/1%/5% sampling rates without impacting production latency >1% p50

Each tenant has a credit tether (initial default 10000 token-equivalent per-day) applied to mirrored traffic; when tether exhausted, mirrored traffic is stopped for that tenant and an admin event recorded
Sandboxed runs are isolated: ephemeral runtime cannot write to production data planes (network egress policy) and logs are tagged and stored separately for 30 days
Rollout dashboard surfaces per-tenant divergence score (token delta, semantic divergence) with automatic flagging when divergence > configured threshold and error rate regresses > 1.5x
Automated rollback trigger can disable traffic duplication for a variant when aggregate divergence or SLA regressions cross thresholds and creates a rollback action in the rollout timeline
End-to-end integration tests and tenant smoke tests exist and pass in CI; load test shows cost overhead for mirrored traffic matches configured sample rate within 5%
Observability: metrics, traces, and structured results for each mirrored request emitted to telemetry pipeline with sampling metadata
technical_notes: Sampling: implement a two-stage stratified sampler. First stage: tenant-level throttle using token-bucket keyed by tenant_id. Second stage: per-route reservoir sampler seeded by request hash to ensure repeatable sampling for debugging. Sandbox: spin up ephemeral worker (container or lightweight process) using a prewarm pool to keep cold-start overhead low. Use short-lived credentials and network policies to prevent production data access. Cost accounting: convert mirrored requests to a token-equivalent unit at ingress and decrement tenant tether before dispatching.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal QA with synthetic tenants (0% production) - 1 week. Phase 1: opt-in pilot with 3 partner tenants at 0.1% sampling for 2 weeks. Phase 2: staged ramp to 1% across low-risk tenants over 1 week. Phase 3: 5% overall with auto-rollback enabled and SRE on-call monitoring for 72 hours. Each phase requires green health check: latency delta p50 < 1.5x, error-rate delta < 1.2x, and cost usage within tether bounds.
monitoring_and_alerting: Emit metrics: mirrored_requests_total, mirrored_tokens_consumed{tenant}, mirror_drop_due_to_tether{tenant}, divergence_score{tenant,route}, sandbox_start_latency, sandbox_processing_latency. Alerts: mirror_tether_exhausted (P1), divergence_alert when >5% tenants exceed divergence threshold (P0), sandbox_start_latency_high (>500ms p95) (P2). Traces must include original_request_id and mirror_trace_id to link flows.
test_plan: Unit tests for sampler logic, integration tests for tether enforcement, isolation tests verifying network/no write to prod, chaos tests introducing worker failure to validate fallback behavior, and load tests at 5x expected traffic. Create a synthetic tenant harness that replays recorded production traces against sandboxes to validate deterministic divergence scoring.
cost_controls: Per-tenant daily token tether (configurable), global spend brake (hard stop at monthly budget), adaptive sampling that reduces mirror rate for tenants nearing tether, and a conservative default sample rate (0.1%) for new tenants. Admin console must show spend burn-rate and allow immediate throttle or disable.
